ev.q: In 2020, 87.2% of residential care communities offered annual influenza vaccination to residents
The percentage of communities offering vaccination to residents ranged from 75.2%
and 77.8% offered annual influenza vaccination to all employees and contract staff members.

Source: National Post-acute and Long-term Care Study, 2020 data.
